user.title: Set up eBay
user.description:
To securely monitor your eBay account, you connect your own free eBay developer keyset. This keeps your credentials private and your API limits dedicated to your Home Assistant instance.

- **Personal developer app**: You will create an application in the eBay Developer Program.
- **Environment**: Choose **Production** for real eBay accounts, or Sandbox for testing.
- **Required keys**: You only need an **App ID (Client ID)** and **Cert ID (Client Secret)**. A Dev ID is not needed.
- **Redirect URL**: You will configure a redirect URL in eBay using Home Assistant's callback to get your **RuName**.
- **Account consent**: Signing in with your actual eBay buyer/seller account happens after entering your keys.

Developer portal: {developer_console_url}
Detailed guide: {oauth_setup_guide_url}

menu_options.redirect_guidance: Start guided setup: Configure redirect URL & RuName (Recommended)
menu_options.credentials: I already have my keyset: Enter credentials directly

redirect_guidance.title: Configure eBay redirect URL (RuName)
redirect_guidance.description:
Before entering credentials, configure your Home Assistant redirect URL in the eBay Developer portal.

**Home Assistant OAuth callback URL** (copy this value):
`{callback_url}`

**Setup Instructions**:
1. Open your eBay application keys: {developer_console_url}
2. Under **Your eBay Sign-in Settings**, click **Add eBay Redirect URL** (or expand an existing one).
3. Set **Display Title** to `Home Assistant` (note: Display Title is only a label, NOT your RuName).
4. Paste the callback URL above into **both** fields:
   - **Your auth accepted URL**
   - **Your auth declined URL**
5. If asked for a privacy policy URL, use: {privacy_policy_url}
6. Click **Save** in eBay. Once saved, eBay generates your unique **RuName** (eBay Redirect URL name).
7. Copy the generated RuName, App ID, and Cert ID into the next step.

*Important*: RuName is a long hyphenated identifier generated by eBay after saving. It is NOT the callback URL or Display Title.

Detailed guide: {oauth_setup_guide_url}

credentials.title: Enter eBay application keys
credentials.description:
Enter the application credentials from your eBay Developer account ({developer_console_url}).

- **App ID (Client ID)**: The application identifier for the selected environment.
- **Cert ID (Client Secret)**: The secret key for the selected environment.
- **RuName**: The unique redirect name generated by eBay after saving your redirect with callback URL `{callback_url}`.

Do not use legacy Auth'n'Auth user tokens or developer test tokens. Home Assistant will prompt you to authorize your regular eBay account after submitting this form.

Detailed guide: {oauth_setup_guide_url}
Privacy policy: {privacy_policy_url}

data_description.client_id: Shown near the top of the eBay application keys page (App ID). Distinct from Dev ID and Cert ID.
data_description.client_secret: The secret (Cert ID) belonging to the same production or sandbox keyset.
data_description.environment: Select Production for real eBay accounts, or Sandbox for test accounts.
data_description.manual_authorization: Enable only if your browser environment cannot complete the automatic callback (such as network firewalls or redirected callback URL issues). Displays a consent URL and allows pasting the authorization code or callback URL directly.
data_description.runame: Generated by eBay after saving the redirect under "Your eBay Sign-in Settings." It usually looks like a long hyphenated identifier. It is NOT the callback URL and NOT the Display Title.
data_description.site_id: Select your eBay marketplace. Defaults to eBay United States.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthorize eBay
reauth_confirm.description: Continue to re-enter the Cert ID / Client secret and authorize again with the regular eBay account you want Home Assistant to monitor. This is required when the refresh token was rejected or when newly enabled features need additional eBay OAuth scopes.

oauth.title: Authorize eBay
oauth.description:
Manual authorization is intended only when the automatic browser callback does not complete.

1. Open the consent URL below.
2. Sign into the regular eBay account you want Home Assistant to monitor.
3. Approve read-only access.
4. Paste the complete final callback URL below.
5. Paste only the authorization code if the full URL is unavailable.

Pasting the full callback URL allows Home Assistant to validate OAuth state.

This consent requests the scopes required for currently enabled features (core buying/selling by default). Enabling optional seller-operation modules later may prompt reauthorization for additional scopes. Disabling a feature stops its API calls but does not revoke granted scopes.

{consent_url}

menu_option_descriptions.general: Poll interval used as the base refresh cadence.
menu_option_descriptions.buying_alerts: Watchlist, bidding, ending-soon timing, and price-drop alerts.
menu_option_descriptions.selling: Active listings and optional Sell Analytics views.
menu_option_descriptions.seller_operations: Orders, seller standards, feedback, messages, account privileges, and finances.
menu_option_descriptions.entities: How many per-item entities Home Assistant creates.
menu_option_descriptions.diagnostics: Where to find diagnostic entities, Repairs, and refresh behavior.
menu_option_descriptions.save: Apply all section changes. May start reauthorization if new scopes are needed.

general.title: General
general.description: Buying, selling, and active orders refresh on this poll interval. Messages refresh less often; feedback and analytics hourly; seller standards daily.

data_description.poll_interval: Base refresh cadence (5–1440 minutes). Slower sections such as feedback, analytics, and seller standards refresh on longer fixed schedules.

buying_alerts.title: Buying and alerts
buying_alerts.description: These settings apply mainly when Buying is enabled. After saving this step you can manage per-item price-drop targets. Targets require matching pinned item IDs under Entities.

data_description.buying_enabled: Fetches watchlist and bidding items from eBay. Disable to stop buying API calls and related entities.
data_description.ending_soon_threshold: How soon before an item ends it counts as ending soon for sensors, calendars, and events. Most useful when Buying is enabled.
data_description.watched_price_change_min_percent: Minimum absolute percent change required before directional watched-price events fire. Use 0 to emit on any numeric change. Requires Buying.
data_description.watched_price_drop_threshold: Optional global amount. Leave blank to disable. Compared only against listings in the matching currency. Requires Buying.
data_description.watched_price_drop_currency: Required when a global threshold is set. Normalized to uppercase (for example USD). Requires Buying.

price_targets.title: Price-drop targets
price_targets.description: Current targets: {price_targets_summary}. Add targets for pinned listings, or choose Done to return to the options menu.

menu_option_descriptions.price_target_add: Set a price-drop amount and currency for one pinned item ID.

price_target_add.title: Add price-drop target
price_target_add.description: Choose a pinned item ID, then set the target amount and currency. Per-item targets override the global threshold. Requires Buying.

data_description.item_id: Must already be listed under Entities → Pinned item IDs.
data_description.amount: Nonnegative amount in the selected currency.
data_description.currency: Common currencies are listed; you can also type another ISO code.

selling.title: Selling
selling.description: Active listing telemetry from the Trading API. {missing_scope_note}

data_description.selling_enabled: Fetches active listings, sold/unsold classification, Trading views, and best offers. Disable to stop selling API calls and related entities.
data_description.analytics_enabled: Requires Selling (active listing IDs). Adds 30-day Sell Analytics views and may require OAuth reauthorization for the Sell Analytics scope.

seller_operations.title: Seller operations
seller_operations.description: Optional seller modules use additional OAuth scopes. Enabling a module without those scopes soft-fails until you reauthorize. {missing_scope_note}

data.seller_standards_enabled: Enable seller standards and service metrics

data_description.fulfillment_enabled: Fetches paid orders, shipment status, and open payment disputes. May require OAuth reauthorization for Fulfillment and payment-dispute scopes.
data_description.seller_standards_enabled: Fetches seller level, evaluation dates, and customer-service metrics. May require OAuth reauthorization for Sell Analytics.
data_description.feedback_enabled: Fetches feedback score and recent rating counts. May require OAuth reauthorization for Feedback.
data_description.messages_enabled: Fetches unread conversation counts without storing message bodies. May require OAuth reauthorization for Messages.
data_description.account_privileges_enabled: Fetches seller registration status and listing amount/quantity used vs remaining, plus a near-limit warning. May require OAuth reauthorization for sell.account.readonly.
data_description.finances_enabled: Fetches available/pending/held funds, last payout, failed/returned payouts, and daily/monthly fees/refunds/net. Unsupported on marketplaces that require request signing. May require OAuth reauthorization for sell.finances.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Controls how many per-item entities are created. Summary sensors for enabled features are always available.

data_description.entity_mode: minimal creates no per-item entities; balanced selects a capped set; detailed allows more listings within the cap. Summary sensors are unaffected.
data_description.per_item_cap: Limits the number of selected item listings. Each selected listing can create multiple Home Assistant entities depending on item type.
data_description.pinned_item_ids: Select known listings from the last poll, or type an eBay item ID that is not listed yet. Use letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen only. Pinned IDs stay in the per-item selection when entity mode is not minimal, and are required for per-item price-drop targets under Buying and alerts.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description:
Persistent problems appear under Settings → Repairs (missing scopes, invalid Site ID, repeated partial failures, truncation).

For technical detail, enable the disabled-by-default diagnostic sensors on the eBay device and download integration diagnostics.

Refresh cadence: buying/selling/orders use the poll interval; messages are slower; feedback and analytics are hourly; seller standards are daily. Full Refresh fetches every enabled section; section refresh buttons refresh only Buying, Selling, Feedback, Seller operations, or Analytics.

save.title: Cannot save options
save.description: Fix the price-alert or pinned-target errors below, then return to Buying and alerts or Entities before saving again. {missing_scope_note}

error.invalid_price_target: Enter a nonnegative amount and a currency code for a pinned item.
error.duplicate_price_target: Each pinned item ID may appear only once in price targets.
error.target_not_pinned: Price target item IDs must also be listed in pinned item IDs under Entities.
error.invalid_pinned_item_ids: Pinned item IDs must be eBay IDs (letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen only).

confirm.title: Reauthorize eBay
confirm.description: Your eBay authorization is no longer valid. Confirm to start reauthorization with the account Home Assistant monitors.

missing_scope.title: eBay feature is missing OAuth scope

confirm.title: Reauthorize for {feature}
confirm.description: The {feature} module is enabled but this account is missing required OAuth scope(s): {scopes}. Confirm to reauthorize and grant the missing scopes.

site_id.title: Choose a valid Site ID
site_id.description: Site ID `{site_id}` does not map to a known eBay marketplace. Analytics and seller-standards marketplace metrics cannot run correctly until you pick a supported Site ID.

error.invalid_site_id: Choose a Site ID from the supported list.

truncated_collection.title: eBay {collection} data is consistently truncated
truncated_collection.description: The `{collection}` collection has been truncated on every recent refresh because the integration hit its page budget. Some items may be missing from sensors and automations. Download diagnostics if you need details for support.

partial_failure.title: Repeated eBay partial failure: {category}
partial_failure.description: The `{category}` data source has failed on consecutive refreshes. Temporary network issues are ignored; this repair appears only when the problem persists. Check diagnostics or disable the related optional feature if it is not needed.

seller_ops_unavailable.title: eBay {feature} API unavailable for this account
seller_ops_unavailable.description: The {feature} API has failed on consecutive refreshes. This often means the connected account cannot use that seller-operation endpoint. Disable the feature in options if you do not need it, or contact eBay if the account should have access.
